title: Transfer limits, routing codes and charges - explained
content: Transfer limits and fees can vary by product, channel and customer configuration. An IFSC identifies a participating branch for relevant Indian transfers, while a transaction reference identifies an instruction; neither should be guessed from a customer's name.
